sentence: Tella teẓra dakken yella yezmer ad yeg akk ayen umi yezmer.
credits: Sentence from Tatoeba by Igider (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
translations: She knew that he'd done his best.

usageExamples: Yenna-d Tom dakken Mary tella tnehher takeṛṛust-nni.
Tom said Mary was driving the car.
